claims.statement: Tom Allen was thrown out of his buggy on Saturday, 1892-09-10, when his horse became uncontrollable during his usual afternoon drive.
claims.excerpt: Tom was out taking his usual afternoon drive,when his horse became uncontrollable.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was confined to his bed from Tuesday, 1892-09-13, with a very painful illness caused by the shaking up from the fall; the illness was not thought to be serious.
claims.excerpt: While his illness is extremely painful, it is not thought to be serious.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was described as the veteran ex-champion heavy-weight of America.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen,the veteran ex-champion heavy-weight of America, has been confined to his bed since Tuesday

notes: Dates worked out from the paper's date (1892-09-15): last Saturday is 1892-09-10, Tuesday is 1892-09-13.
